grouping_principle: A post-discharge transition is a Reason for Encounter that requires source-aware reconciliation of symptoms, medicines, pending results, follow-up plans and support without inferring a diagnosis or readmission decision.

coverage_goal: discharge identity date source reliability and document availability
current course new symptoms function intake and time-sensitive warning features
actual medicines changes discrepancies access suspected effects and conflicting instructions
pending results follow-up ownership appointments access barriers devices services and caregiver support
patient concern expected help explicit uncertainty and clinician handoff

definition_of_done: current official NICE AHRQ WHO and build-time STOM source manifest with refresh metadata
licensed-source boundary records and metadata-only retention where required
atomic safety and transition questions with conditional detail collection
routine emergency urgent proxy conflict dataAbsentReason and multi-RFE simulations
privacy validator build unit simulation mapping and Coverage gates pass
constraints: Do not infer a post-discharge complication, diagnosis, readmission requirement or treatment change.
Do not tell a person to start, stop or change a medicine.
Do not treat a LOINC document title as an exact individual question mapping.
Keep generated content unreviewed and research_only until clinical review and Korean local-protocol alignment.
